description: This file contains service functions for managing orders in an e-commerce system, including creating orders, listing user orders, and retrieving specific orders using SQLAlchemy asynchronous sessions.

methods.name: Order create_order(db: AsyncSession, user_id: int, items: list[dict])
methods.description: Creates an order with provided items, updating stock quantities, calculating total amount, and saving the order to the database.

methods.name: List[Order] list_orders_for_user(db: AsyncSession, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all orders made by a specific user, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: Optional[Order] get_order(db: AsyncSession, order_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a specific order for a user based on order ID and user ID.
